result.summary:
Repo /home/user/KOD-Machine holds 11 experiments/baselines spread over 4 branches; every one that was run ended negative or inadmissible, and every validation window that exists has now been consumed at least once.
LONG side, "already-ran" detectors (E1 IDX F1_ARA; E2 US+crypto G2_RET30): detection is real (9.3x / 5.4x / 4.6x matched-random precision at +30%, p=0.005 floor) but coverage is tiny (recall 9.8% / 0.9% / 0.1%) and buying the next close/open loses in all three markets (-4.06% vs -0.53%; -3.65% vs -0.60%, repaired -4.85% vs -1.13%; -1.90% vs +1.42%). Mechanism: the flag fires inside the move; median 5-session return after a flag is about -10% vs 0% matched; fills select the fading moves; on IDX 339/1,042 attempts cannot fill because the name is still locked at ARA.
Execution-plan search on the long side (E3, IDX, 108 pre-registered plans x 3 ARA detectors, 2021-22 discovery): 0 admissible; 3 beat matched random at p<0.05 but all 108 lost money in 2022 (edge only in the 2021 hot year). Validation 2023 was not run; family exhausted.
SHORT side (E4, crypto, PR #7 unmerged): v1 144 plans, 0 admissible (hit rate >=50% in 102 plans but 0 of 144 positive in 2021 and 0 with 1st percentile >= -50%; worst real squeeze GMT +424%). v2 (liquidation model + BTC<50d regime, a declared second design pass on discovery) admitted 31/288, froze G2_RET30_BEAR|pullback3|first_up|h2 (+5.82% vs 0.00%, hit 70.3%, 407 trades) and FAILED 2023 validation: 34 scored, avg -1.50%, p=0.78, 3/34 liquidated (8.8%). Mechanism: selling insurance; fat left tail; regime scarce in 2023. Crypto short family exhausted; US short never run.
Breakout baseline (US_BREAKOUT_v1, local-only branch claude/us-breakout-v1, frozen then run once on 2023 under EXEC-US-v2.1): 11,833 filled, mean net -0.180% vs matched -0.138%, D=-0.042pp, p=0.856, hit 19.9%; NO EDGE ESTABLISHED; a stop-based 5-session position with these costs loses whether or not a breakout preceded it.
Capacity/fill audits (IDX_CAUSAL_CAPACITY_v1 FILL-C: -3.64% vs -0.44%, not material; CORRECTION_01 withdrew the FILL-C recommendation) and data repairs (E2 US v1/v2/v3: quarantine is outcome-correlated, -9.17% vs -1.75% in R1b; recommended cost-bound-instead-of-exclusion never run) changed magnitudes, never signs.
Single-event pilot (ZEALAND_PILOT_v1, KOD lab): NO_ACTIONABLE_EDGE; 114% of the +37.9% move occurred before the first possible home-listing execution; post-release entries -16% to -19% at +5 sessions; KOD-DET-v0 detectors all NO_SIGNAL.
Only pre-event separator ever found: prior 20-session volatility (matched-set AUC 0.68 IDX, 0.78 US, 0.56 crypto); volume surge, breakout and IGNITION analogues carry no information on the start day (AUC 0.48-0.52). No experiment has turned volatility into a tested early detector.
Frozen detectors: MOONSHOT_E1_D1 v1.1 (F1_ARA), MOONSHOT_E2_US_D1/CRYPTO_D1 v1 (G2_RET30), MOONSHOT_E3_D1 (SELECTED=None, never created), MOONSHOT_E4_D1 (SELECTED=G2_RET30_BEAR plan, frozen as record only, e4 branch), KOD-DET-v0 (5 narrative detectors), PLACEBO_COINFLIP, breakout.py (local branch, not registered).
Sealed holdouts: IDX 2024-01-02..2025-02-21 (backtest.HOLDOUT + e1.Study cut); US/crypto 2024-01-01 onward (E2 protocol; GLOBAL_HOLDOUT coded only on the e4 branch). Consumed: IDX 2021-22 (E1 family selection, E3 108 plans), IDX 2023 (E1 detection+trading, FILL-C rerun), US 2020-07..22 (E2 selection; breakout pipeline check Q1 2022), US 2023 (E2 + 9 repair reruns + EXEC-US-v1 replay + EXEC-US-v2 demos + US_BREAKOUT_v1), crypto 2020-07..22 (E2 selection, E4 v1 144 + v2 288 plans), crypto 2023 (E2 trading, E4 v2 validation).
Prospective ledger: 17 scans, 87 decisions (all PASS or NOT EXECUTABLE under PAPER-POLICY-v1..v4), 1 scored outcome (CRYPTO MET: correct rejection, would have been -16.99%). Written but unrun protocols: E3_US_RETENTION_v1 (codex branch), repair_v3 cost-bound rerun, E4 US side, E3's suggested IDX regime condition, E4's suggested position-cap sizing.
